briefs.README-015: Fix README.md Install block (around line 96-104): the documented path uses bare 'pip install -e .' which fails with PEP 668 on externally-managed Python. Change the primary install path to create/use a venv (python3 -m venv .venv, source .venv/bin/activate, then pip install -e .) or use pipx explicitly. The block must complete rc=0 with 'auger --version' printing auger v0.3. Do not modify any other section.
briefs.README-016: Fix README.md substrate boot command (around line 24-29, also line 68): 'node bin/duckbrain.js http' defaults to port 3000 which collides on shared hosts. Add a port-preflight or free-port selection before the boot command in the first Quick Start section. Direct readers to an alternate port or include the existing alternate-port recipe earlier. Preserve the later warning about data-dir not isolating instances.
briefs.README-017: Fix README.md serve command (around line 251-255): 'AUGER_NS=myproject python3 auger.py serve --port 8765' fails EADDRINUSE on hosts where 8765 is occupied. State that 8765 is a default/example port that must be free, provide a free-port preflight or use a non-default example port, and ensure the matching curl URL uses the same port.
